grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (rising 10th to 12th for writing and art)
name: Lewis and Clark Precollege Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take a summer program on campus. Subjects include health careers, data, theatre, studio art, writing and debate.
who_can_apply: High school students going into grades 9 to 12. Writing and Studio Art are for rising grades 10 to 12. The page lists grades, not ages.
pay_detail: Costs listed for 2026: $1,800 for Circular Innovation, Data in Action and Future Health Leaders. $3,600 for Theatre. $3,800 for the Writing Workshop. $3,650 for Studio Art. A $500 deposit is not refundable. Some partial scholarships are available.
duration: Varies by program. Writing and Studio Art run June 20 to July 3, 2027.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates for five programs are not set yet on the program page. The balance is due by May 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Precollege Program Interest Form on the program page. For questions, email summercamps@lclark.edu.
notes: Summer 2027 costs are still being set. These programs do not give college credit. Students who finish a program and are later admitted get a guaranteed minimum of $20,000 a year in renewable scholarship funding.
